faculty.name: Joanne Davila
faculty.summary: Studies romantic relationships and sexual communication among sexual and gender minority adolescents and adults, using daily diary and observational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性少数青少年和成年人的恋爱关系和性沟通，使用日常日记和观察方法。

faculty.name: Candice Alfano
faculty.summary: Studies the role of sleep in emotional and behavioral outcomes in children, developing interventions for trauma and foster care.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠在儿童情绪和行为结果中的作用，开发针对创伤和寄养儿童的干预措施。

faculty.name: Kristin Bernard
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of early life stress on children’s neurobiological and behavioral development, and the role of sensitive caregiving in preventing maladaptive outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期生活压力对儿童神经生物学和行为发展的影响，以及敏感养育在预防不良结果中的作用。

faculty.name: Julian Burger
faculty.summary: Develops new methods for personalizing psychotherapy using network analysis and computational approaches, focusing on LGBTQ individuals.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发个性化心理治疗的新方法，利用网络分析和计算建模技术，重点关注LGBTQ群体。

faculty.name: Lu Dong
faculty.summary: Studies how sleep affects mental health outcomes among underserved populations, focusing on stigma, discrimination, and neighborhood environments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠如何影响边缘化群体的心理健康结果，重点关注污名、歧视和社区环境。

faculty.name: Nicholas Eaton
faculty.summary: Studies psychopathology, comorbidity, and mental health disparities, using AI and psychometrics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理障碍、共病和心理健康差异，使用人工智能和心理测量学方法。

faculty.name: Daniel Klein
faculty.summary: Studies the development and course of mood disorders in children and adults, focusing on early temperament and emotional reactivity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人情绪障碍的发展和病程，重点关注早期情绪反应和气质。

faculty.name: Briana Last
faculty.summary: Studies the social determinants of mental health and the implementation of mental health services, using mixed methods and policy research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理健康的社会决定因素以及心理健康服务的实施，使用混合方法和政策研究。

faculty.name: Aprajita Mohanty
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain predicts and processes emotional stimuli, using fMRI and cognitive behavioral tasks to understand anxiety and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何预测和处理情绪刺激，使用功能性磁共振成像和认知行为任务来理解焦虑和注意力。

faculty.name: Brady Nelson
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive, emotional, and motivational mechanisms of anxiety disorders and depression, using psychophysiological and neuroimaging methods in child, adolescent, and adult populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍和抑郁障碍的认知、情绪和动机机制，使用心理生理学和神经影像学方法在儿童、青少年和成人中进行研究。

faculty.name: Brenda Anderson
faculty.summary: Studies how exercise and stress affect the brain, using behavioral and neuroanatomical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动和压力对大脑的影响，使用行为和神经解剖学方法。

faculty.name: Turhan Canli
faculty.summary: Studies the role of loneliness in cognitive decline and financial decision-making, using gene expression analysis and functional MRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究孤独感对认知衰退和财务决策的影响，使用基因表达分析和功能性磁共振成像。

faculty.name: Hoi-Chung Leung
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of cognitive processes, particularly visual-spatial working memory and prefrontal cortex function using fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程的神经基础，特别是视觉-空间工作记忆和前额叶皮层的功能，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）。

faculty.name: Ryan Parsons
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of fear learning and memory consolidation using Pavlovian fear conditioning in rats.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究恐惧学习和记忆巩固的神经生物学机制，使用大鼠的经典条件恐惧学习模型。

faculty.name: Naftali Raz
faculty.summary: Studies individual differences in cognitive aging, focusing on brain changes and risk factors in older adults without dementia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究老年人认知老化中的个体差异，关注无痴呆老年人的大脑变化和风险因素。

faculty.name: Susan Brennan
faculty.summary: Studies the psychology of language use in interactive spoken dialogue, using eye-tracking to measure language processing and nonverbal communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言使用中的心理过程，特别是在互动口语对话中，使用眼动追踪来衡量语言处理和非言语交流。

faculty.name: Cameron Jones
faculty.summary: Studies the similarities and differences between humans and AI systems, how people interact with AI, and the long-term psychological impacts of AI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类与人工智能系统之间的相似性和差异性，人们如何与人工智能互动以及人工智能对人类心理的长期影响。

faculty.name: Sahil Luthra
faculty.summary: Studies how speech perception and cognition interact, using behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言感知与认知之间的交互作用，使用行为实验、计算建模和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Suparna Rajaram
faculty.summary: Studies how social interactions affect memory accuracy and the emergence of collective memory, using collaborative recall experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会互动如何影响记忆准确性以及集体记忆的形成，使用协作回忆实验。

faculty.name: Lauren Richmond
faculty.summary: Studies everyday cognition and working memory in younger and older adults, developing interventions to improve daily functioning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究日常认知和工作记忆在年轻和老年成人中的差异，开发提高日常功能的干预措施。

faculty.name: Gregory Zelinsky
faculty.summary: Studies visual cognition, visual search, and eye movements using cognitive, computational, and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉认知、视觉搜索和眼动，使用认知、计算和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Antonio Freitas
faculty.summary: Studies how motivation and cognitive control interact to influence social behavior, using various experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机与认知控制的相互作用如何影响社会行为，采用多种实验方法。

faculty.name: Sheri Levy
faculty.summary: Studies the interrelated topics of ableism, ageism, aging, climate change, and mental health using a multi-method approach including experiments, surveys, and interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究残疾人歧视、年龄歧视、老龄化、气候变化和心理健康，采用实验、调查和干预等多种方法。

faculty.name: Marci Lobel
faculty.summary: Studies stress, coping, and their effects on reproductive health, particularly prenatal maternal stress and its impact on birth outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力、应对策略及其对生殖健康的影响，特别是孕期压力对分娩结果的影响。

faculty.name: Stacey Scott
faculty.summary: Studies stress, emotions, and health across the lifespan using longitudinal and intensive measurement designs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生命历程中的压力、情绪与健康，采用纵向和密集测量设计。

faculty.name: Andrea Pittarello
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological and social factors influencing donation behavior and workplace harassment perceptions, using real-world data and experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究捐赠行为和社会因素以及职场骚扰感知的心理学和社会学因素，使用实地数据和实验方法。

faculty.name: Margaret Echelbarger
faculty.summary: Studies consumer behavior and decision-making processes in marketing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究消费者行为和营销中的决策过程。

faculty.name: Katherine Jonas
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点在于记忆和注意力。

faculty.name: Brittain Mahaffey
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on working memory and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

faculty.name: Nikhil Palekar
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their disorders, focusing on clinical aspects of psychiatry and behavioral health.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其障碍，重点在于精神病学和行为健康方面的临床方面。

faculty.name: Heidi Preis
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive processes involved in decision-making during pregnancy, using behavioral experiments and surveys.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究妊娠期间决策的认知过程，使用行为实验和问卷调查的方法。

faculty.name: James E. Swain
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点关注记忆和注意力。

faculty.name: Jared Van Snellenberg
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on working memory and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

faculty.name: Arthur Aron
faculty.summary: Studies how shared activities enhance relationship quality and the neural circuits involved in close relationships.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究共同活动如何增强人际关系质量及其相关神经回路的作用。

faculty.name: Arthur Samuel
faculty.summary: Studies how humans process spoken language, focusing on word recognition and the role of time in perceptual processing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何处理口语，重点在于单词识别以及时间在感知处理中的作用。

faculty.name: Ying-Wan Lam
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。
